finite_arithmetic.scope: Digest equality is finite-fixture evidence. Structural operand/output checks certify this generated straight-line allocation by induction for arbitrary plane values; they do not prove generator/hash equivalence, handler/caller allocation or a collision success law.

projection_controls.p01: low 11 bits of word 0 followed by low 10 bits of word 1
projection_controls.p23: low 11 bits of word 2 followed by bits 11..20 of word 3

duplicate_statistic_fixture.scope: Artificial outputs; repeated-entry count is not all equal pairs. Returned fixture pair is not a cryptographic witness.

interface_controls.warning: Do not call loss(plan(18)) or loss(plan(20)): the source constructs cmax+1 Poisson terms. This unsafe billion-term path was not executed.

declared_accounting.scope: Exact arithmetic of declared full-width formulas after floating-point selection. Handler, generator and recovery allowances and success probability are not independently certified; abstract memory is not Python RSS. Smaller-register fallback prices are not audited here.

synthetic_search.scope: One step each of artificial constant maps; no BLAKE3 search or collision witnesses.

experiment_contracts.scope: Mocked routing, event and observation contracts; no target, ideal-control or fresh-key birthday runs.

documented_example.scope: Finite circuit generation and register assignment only; neither selftest nor search.

scope: Pinned copied-source finite arithmetic, structural straight-line allocation, synthetic flow, declared accounting and mocked interface controls.
